Kashkoul Studio · استوديو كشكول · website prototypes

Three doors
into the same room.

Three directions for the Kashkoul Studio site. All three share the Academy's palette, fonts, badge logo and footer "family strip", so anyone landing on either site knows they're related — but each has a different mood and a different booking idea. Open them side by side with the Academy site.

Prototype 1The Set

Dark, cinematic, production-first. Full-bleed hero, a "now booking" REC badge, a walk-through of the rooms, gear list, three rate cards. The most "studio" of the three.

  • Dark green + mustard
  • Rooms walk-through
  • Rate cards
  • Masonry gallery
Prototype 2Paper

The Academy's closest sibling: paper background, terra hero with the brand pattern, taped polaroids, a dictionary-card for "studio". Includes a tap-a-slot weekly availability grid.

  • Paper + terra
  • Notebook motifs
  • Weekly slot picker
  • Magazine spreads
Prototype 3Terra

Bold poster: huge type on terracotta, hard ink borders, a drag-to-scroll photo strip, a space picker with a sticky preview, and a 4-tap "build your booking" estimator that writes the WhatsApp message.

  • Terra + ink + mustard
  • Booking builder
  • FAQ
  • Poster type

What's real

  • All photos come from docs/Kashkoul_Space.pdf (resized to 1800px).
  • Venue specs and gear list are from page 2 of that PDF: open-plan salon, 3 production rooms (3×4 m, 4×5 m), 3×3 m acoustic room, kitchen, 2 balconies, 3 restrooms; Canon EOS R8, Amaran 550, 2× Mars softbox, 3 backdrops, reflector set, Eco PowerStation, tripod.
  • Colours, fonts and logo lockups follow KashkoulBrandGuides.pdf.
  • WhatsApp number and map pin are the Academy's.

What's a placeholder

  • Every page has a "Show placeholders" button (bottom corner) that highlights everything still to confirm: dotted underline.
  • Prices, minimum booking, deposit and cancellation policy, hours, capacity, parking, audio gear, Instagram handle, studio email, building/floor.
  • The acoustic room has no photo yet — the curtain shot stands in.
  • The availability grid (Paper) and the price estimator (Terra) use demo numbers.
  • Suggested sub-brand: Kashkoul Studio · استوديو كشكول, at studio.kashkoul.org; the same badge logo with "Studio" as the descriptor.
